name: conceive
author: board 29 builder, item conceive
purpose: BREADTH: prompts a person conceives, over many kinds, each with a rubric stated without a model wherever one can be stated. It is not a depth set; bench/public.mjs and bench/essay.mjs measure depth.
source: every prompt written for this file by its author; none copied from bench/site-ask.mjs, web/ask.mjs EXAMPLES, bench/essay-prompts.json or the public sets under bench/fixtures/public (bench/conceive.mjs copyCheck re-reads those files on every run)
split: development: the whole file. There is no held out half: this is a census of what the organism answers, and no tier, threshold or rubric was fit to a score on it.

Summarize in one sentence: The town council met on Tuesday to discuss the old stone bridge over the river. Engineers reported cracks in two of its supports and said it could no longer safely carry trucks. After a long debate, the council voted to close the bridge to heavy vehicles and to ask the state for money to repair it next spring.

Summarize this in under 25 words: Mina started a small coffee cart outside the train station. At first she sold only a dozen cups a day, but she learned the names of her regular customers, added a cheaper small size and began opening an hour earlier. Within a year the cart had a line every morning and she hired two helpers.

Give a three-bullet summary of this passage: The school library replaced its old desktop computers with laptops that students can borrow for a week. The change was paid for by a local business. Librarians say more students now visit after classes, although some teachers worry the laptops will be lost or damaged.

TL;DR in one short sentence: Our hiking group planned to climb the north ridge on Saturday, but the forecast shows heavy rain and strong wind in the afternoon. We will start two hours earlier instead, turn back at the saddle if the weather arrives, and meet at the trailhead at six in the morning.

Summarize the main point in one sentence: Researchers followed two hundred office workers for six months. Those who took a ten minute walk after lunch reported feeling less tired in the afternoon than those who stayed at their desks, although the walkers did not finish more work. The authors say the result is small and needs a larger study.

Summarize in under 20 words: A lighthouse keeper on a small island kept a logbook for forty years. In it he recorded every storm, every ship that passed and the birds that nested on the rocks. After he died, his logbook helped scientists learn how the island's weather had changed over time.
